/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -c 'import asyncio
import inspect
import sys
import click
print(\"runtime:\", sys.version.split()[0], \"click:\", click.__version__, \"source:\", click.__file__)
calls = []
@click.command()
@click.pass_context
async def deferred(ctx):
    calls.append(\"executed\")
    return 42
rv = deferred.main([], standalone_mode=False)
assert inspect.isawaitable(rv) and calls == []
assert click.get_current_context(silent=True) is None
print(\"async callback: returned awaitable; body not run; context already popped\")
print(\"decorated callback recognized as coroutine function:\", inspect.iscoroutinefunction(deferred.callback))
rv.close()
seen = []
@click.command()
async def child():
    seen.append(click.get_current_context(silent=True))
parent = click.Context(click.Command(\"parent\"))
with parent:
    rv = parent.invoke(child)
    assert click.get_current_context() is parent
    asyncio.run(rv)
assert seen == [parent]
print(\"invoke child, then await: child body sees parent context\")
async def overlap():
    entered_a = asyncio.Event()
    entered_b = asyncio.Event()
    checked = asyncio.Event()
    finished_b = asyncio.Event()
    ctx_a = click.Context(click.Command(\"a\"))
    ctx_b = click.Context(click.Command(\"b\"))
    observations = []
    async def a():
        with ctx_a:
            entered_a.set()
            await entered_b.wait()
            observations.append(click.get_current_context().command.name)
            checked.set()
            await finished_b.wait()
    async def b():
        await entered_a.wait()
        with ctx_b:
            entered_b.set()
            await checked.wait()
        finished_b.set()
    await asyncio.gather(a(), b())
    assert observations == [\"b\"]
    assert click.get_current_context(silent=True) is None
    print(\"overlapping tasks: task a reads context b\")
asyncio.run(overlap())
print(\"all three probes passed; in-memory only\")'"
